    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

program_source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    blocks = []
    corners = [(-1, -1, 2, -1), (-1, 2, -1, -1), (2, -1, 2, 2), (2, 2, -1, 2)]

    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == grid[r][c + 1] == grid[r + 1][c] == grid[r + 1][c + 1] == 2:
                blocks.append((r, c))

    for r, c in blocks:
        for dr, dc, source_r, source_c in corners:
            row, col = r + dr, c + dc
            color = grid[r + source_r][c + source_c]
            step_r = -1 if dr < 0 else 1
            step_c = -1 if dc < 0 else 1
            first = True

            while 0 <= row < h and 0 <= col < w:
                if not first and grid[row][col] != 0:
                    break
                out[row][col] = color
                next_row, next_col = row + step_r, col + step_c
                wraps_top_left = step_r == 1 and step_c == -1 and any(
                    (next_row, next_col) == (other_r, other_c - 1)
                    and (row, col) == (other_r - 1, other_c)
                    for other_r, other_c in blocks
                    if (other_r, other_c) != (r, c)
                )
                if wraps_top_left:
                    break
                row, col = next_row, next_col
                first = False

    return out
'''
